name: Marcus Finley
bio:
Marcus Finley's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, with a background in political campaign management. After a successful stint navigating the volatile world of Washington D.C., he sought a new challenge and found it in the high-octane environment of racing. He transitioned his skills in message control and public perception to the motorsport arena, quickly establishing himself as a capable operator. 

Marcus takes a data-driven approach to PR, meticulously analyzing media trends and fan engagement metrics to craft targeted campaigns. He believes in proactive communication, shaping narratives rather than simply reacting to events. His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire to elevate the team's image and ensure that their accomplishments receive the recognition they deserve. He has worked with several junior formula teams before making the jump to Prema Racing.

What sets Marcus apart is his ability to see the bigger picture. He understands the complex interplay between on-track performance, sponsorship deals, and public perception, and he leverages this knowledge to create comprehensive PR strategies that deliver tangible results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Marcus is a stocky man with a confident demeanor, often seen adjusting his glasses while contemplating the next PR move.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized spreadsheet detailing media coverage.
Insists on using old-school reporter's notebooks despite having a laptop.
Carries a lucky racing die he rolls before important announcements.
